2. The petitioners have prayed for the following reliefs:
(i) for issuance of writ especially in nature of Mandamus directing to the respondents No.-4 to pay the compensation amount against the acquisition of land of the petitioners for the construction of Patna High Court CWJC No.1469 of 2024(2)

1 IV (Notice U/S 37 (2) of the Act, 30 of 2013 issued in Land Acquisition Case No.-35/2020- 21/35/2021-22 by the respondents No.-2 for the Khesera No.-1829;
(ii) for also issuance of any other appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, command/commands to the respondents for which the petitioners are legally entitled.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that he will be approaching the respondent no.2, the Collector, Samastipur for the redressal of his grievance.
4. Granting such liberty, the writ petition stands disposed of.
